notes: A160217_conjecture (A160217_mathlib.lean): for m > 3 in A003159 the greedy sequence from m equals A160217 from some index on. Gap b(n)-a(n) is nonincreasing (b advances at most as a: 2, 3, 1 by the A003159 pattern); an odd constant gap fails at odd n; an even gap 2e fails at t with t in A003159, t+e not. Also A160217_formula (a(n) = 2n+1 or 2n+2). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.

sources.cite: V. Shevelev, Several results on sequences which are similar to the positive integers, arXiv:0904.2101 (2009)
